# BlueWing Group

> BlueWing Group is an Ahmedabad-based construction group with four specialist companies: BlueWing Design & Construction Pvt. Ltd. (BlueWing DCPL) for turnkey and EPC construction, Bhaarat Precast for precast manufacturing, Sygnific Infra for diaphragm wall foundations, and AluTek for building envelope systems. One group, one accountability across every package.

- Head office: BlueWing House, 3rd floor, The Mangaldeep Capital, Science City, Ahmedabad 380060, Gujarat, India
- Phone: +91 76005 94363, +91 73837 20159
- Email: info@bluewingconstruction.com
- Track record: 38+ clients served, 10+ years of experience, 51 projects (32 completed, 17 under execution), total project value about ₹578 crore
- Certifications: ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001
- Sectors: industrial, institutional, hotels, hospitals, residential and commercial
